_doc: HIWIN MGN7 miniature linear guide: the rail, and its standard carriage (MGN7C) in the rules, its long carriage (MGN7H) as a variant. Figures from HIWIN's MG Series catalogue. Rail along x, its base on the face it is screwed to; the carriage rides over it. Other makers' MGN7 rails share the rail's size and hole pitch; their carriages' ratings differ: give a variant with their figures.
name: rail-mgn7

MGN7C.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

MGN7H.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_width.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_height.rule: The rail's height from the face it is screwed to (HR)
rail_height.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_hole_pitch.rule: Between the rail's mounting holes along it (P)
rail_hole_pitch.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_hole_end.rule: The standard distance from the rail's end to its last hole's centre (E). A rail cut to another length is best cut so E is no more than half the pitch
rail_hole_end.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf; and HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, 2-4-17 standard and maximum lengths of rail: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_hole_diameter.rule: The rail's mounting hole through it, under the counterbore (d)
rail_hole_diameter.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_counterbore_diameter.rule: The counterbore for the screw's head (D)
rail_counterbore_diameter.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_counterbore_depth.rule: The counterbore's depth from the rail's top (h)
rail_counterbore_depth.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_thread.rule: The thread of the rail's screws
rail_thread.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf; and HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, table 2-4-14 rail mounting bolts: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_screw_length.rule: The rail screw HIWIN lists, M2x6, into a tapped face; into a slot nut the length is the fasten check's to choose
rail_screw_length.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, table 2-4-14 rail mounting bolts: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_mass.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_length_max.rule: The longest rail sold in one piece
rail_length_max.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, 2-4-17 standard and maximum lengths of rail: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

rail_parallelism.rule: Running parallelism of the carriage to the rail's base, normal class (C): the rail's length up to which it holds, then the tolerance. A rail shorter than 125 mm takes the 100 to 125 mm row's figure, the largest of the short rows, as the text of the first rows could not be read cleanly
rail_parallelism.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, table 2-4-5 accuracy of running parallelism, normal class (C): https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_length.rule: The standard carriage's length along the rail with its end seals (L)
carriage_length.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_length_max.rule: The standard carriage's greatest length with its seal lips and screws (L max): the travel is counted from this
carriage_length_max.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_body_length.rule: The standard carriage's steel body, without its end caps (L1)
carriage_body_length.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_hole_x.rule: Between the standard carriage's tapped holes along the rail (C)
carriage_hole_x.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_mass.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

dynamic_rating.rule: The standard carriage's basic dynamic load rating C, 0.98 kN
dynamic_rating.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

static_rating.rule: The standard carriage's basic static load rating C0, 1.24 kN, square to the rail's face
static_rating.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

moment_roll.rule: The standard carriage's static rated moment about the rail's axis (MR)
moment_roll.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

moment_pitch.rule: The standard carriage's static rated moment tipping it end over end (MP)
moment_pitch.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

moment_yaw.rule: The standard carriage's static rated moment turning it across the rail (MY)
moment_yaw.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_stiffness.rule: The standard carriage's radial stiffness at very light preload (Z0), 40 N/µm. A light clearance (ZF) carriage is softer; HIWIN gives no figure for it
carriage_stiffness.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, table 2-4-7 radial stiffness: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_width.rule: The carriage's width across the rail (W)
carriage_width.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_height.rule: The carriage's top over the face the rail is screwed to (H)
carriage_height.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_clearance.rule: The gap under the carriage over that face (H1)
carriage_clearance.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf; and HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, table 2-4-13 shoulder heights and fillets: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_hole_y.rule: Between the carriage's tapped holes across the rail (B)
carriage_hole_y.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_thread.rule: The thread of the carriage's four tapped holes
carriage_thread.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_thread_depth.rule: How deep the carriage's tapped holes go (from Mxl)
carriage_thread_depth.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, the MGN dimension table: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf

carriage_play.rule: The most the carriage moves across its rail with no load, light clearance (ZF): 4 to 10 µm, the class most often sold. Very light preload (Z0) is 0 to 3 µm
carriage_play.source: HIWIN MG Series catalogue 2025 (G99TE24-2410), section 2-4, table 2-4-6 preload classes: https://s3.amazonaws.com/www.motionusa.com/hiwin/2025/MG%20Series-2025.pdf
